entries.taskTitle: Blocker signaling — agents can flag "I'm stuck" instead of false "done"
entries.summary:
ed to `panely/sprint-1`

### Caveats
- The pipeline (Telegram DM, in-app notification, system event) was already wired up for blocker detection in `build-queue.ts` — this commit only closes the type/UI gaps.
- The `detectBlocker` function matches the first blocker pattern found in output. If an agent writes `BLOCKED:` near other trigger phrases (e.g. "cannot verify in Safari"), the Safari pattern may fire first since it's earlier in the array. This is acceptable — both signal a genuine blocker.

entries.taskTitle: Agent memory system — persistent memory files per named agent
entries.summary:
ory` field with full markdown content.

### Validation
- `npm run build` passes cleanly (`✓ Compiled successfully in 2.5s`)
- Pushed to `panely/sprint-1`

### Caveats
- The markdown files are write-append only (no deduplication or pruning) — the Task Log will grow unbounded over time. A trim/prune mechanism would be a logical follow-on.
- `memory/` directory is tracked in git, so agent task log entries will appear as diffs. That's intentional (human-auditable history), but worth being aware of.
